name: Type Chart
description: The elemental multiplication table: fire beats grass, grass beats water, and the numbers behind 'beats'. It is a pure lookup — attacker type, defender type, multiplier — shared verbatim with the Monster Taming pack, which is why it owns the chart and nothing else: no damage (combat.damage_resolver consumes the multiplier it is handed), no statuses (a burn a fire move inflicts is combat.status_effects' row in the ledger), no UI. Being query-driven instead of event-driven is deliberate: the multiplier is needed inside the damage pipeline synchronously, and an event round-trip would deliver the answer a frame late to a resolver that already moved on.

inputs.name: chart
inputs.description: attacker → defender → multiplier table. Missing pairs mean neutral (1.0), so a two-element game is a four-line file and a twenty-element game is still just data.

inputs.name: stabBonus
inputs.description: Same-type attack bonus when the attacker's own element matches the move's. Rewards thematic teams without making off-type moves useless.

inputs.name: immunityThreshold
inputs.description: Multipliers below this report as immunity. 'Barely works' and 'does not work' are different feelings, and the chart should say which.

outputs.name: lastMultiplier
outputs.description: Result of the most recent lookup, for combat log and floating text.

outputs.name: lastEffectiveness
outputs.description: immune | resisted | neutral | effective — the word the UI shouts.
